e.title: Python for Pricing
e.summary: 免费 Python 定价课程（python-for-pricing.co.uk）：GLM/ML/模型注册的实操教程
e.body: Python for Pricing（python-for-pricing.co.uk）是免费开源的精算定价 Python 课程：GLM、机器学习定价、模型注册（MLflow）等章节，从数据到部署的实操路径。对 RIAA：定价方法论的免费中文友好教程——与 [[insurance-pricing-course]]（burning-cost 12 模块）互补：一个偏系统方法、一个含工程实践（模型注册）；衔接 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）、[[tweedie-python]]（分布定价）；自学者按章节跟练即可搭出定价实验流水线。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：官网确认（免费 Python 定价课程：GLM/ML/模型注册），未逐章实测
e.summary_en: Free Python pricing course (python-for-pricing.co.uk): hands-on GLM/ML/model-registry tutorials
e.summary_hk: 免費 Python 定價課程（python-for-pricing.co.uk）：GLM/ML/模型註冊的實操教程
e.body_en: Python for Pricing (python-for-pricing.co.uk) is a free, open-source actuarial pricing course in Python: chapters on GLM, machine-learning pricing and model registries (MLflow), a hands-on path from data to deployment. For RIAA: a free pricing-methodology tutorial — complementing [[insurance-pricing-course]] (the burning-cost 12-module course): one leans systematic methods, the other includes engineering practice (model registries); connects [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) and [[tweedie-python]] (distributional pricing); self-learners can follow chapter by chapter to build a pricing experiment pipeline.
e.body_hk: Python for Pricing（python-for-pricing.co.uk）是免費開源的精算定價 Python 課程：GLM、機器學習定價、模型註冊（MLflow）等章節，從數據到部署的實操路徑。對 RIAA：定價方法論的免費中文友好教程——與 [[insurance-pricing-course]]（burning-cost 12 模塊）互補：一個偏系統方法、一個含工程實踐（模型註冊）；銜接 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）、[[tweedie-python]]（分佈定價）；自學者按章節跟練即可搭出定價實驗流水線。
